context: Two sisters discuss attending a family member's ceremony
purpose: Teach: 礼拝/葬儀/福音/民衆/講じ/クリスチャン/詩人/規範

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おじさんの葬儀のこと、教会で礼拝の形式でやるって聞いたけど本当？
lines.en: About uncle's funeral — I heard they're doing it as a church service. Is that true?
lines.style: Soft maternal tone, gentle but concerned about details.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ええ、本人が敬虔なクリスチャンだったから、福音書を読む場面もあるみたい。
lines.en: Yes, since he was a devout Christian, apparently they'll also read from the gospel.
lines.style: Calm explanatory voice, slightly hushed and respectful.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そうなんだ。私たち、宗教の規範とか作法を全然知らないから心配で。
lines.en: I see. We don't know any of the religious customs or rules, so I'm worried.
lines.style: Hesitant and humble, voicing quiet anxiety to her sister.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 大丈夫よ、牧師さんが民衆向けに分かりやすく説明してくれるから。
lines.en: It'll be fine — the pastor explains things in a way ordinary people can follow.
lines.style: Reassuring older-sister tone, warm and matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 亡くなる前、彼は好きな詩人の言葉を口ずさんでたって聞いたの。
lines.en: I heard that before he passed, he was murmuring lines from his favorite poet.
lines.style: Wistful and tender, voice lowering with emotion.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: うん。だから家族で何か対策を講じて、お別れの会も少し工夫しようって話してるの。
lines.en: Right. So the family is taking some steps to make the farewell gathering a bit special.
lines.style: Thoughtful, organizing tone — the practical aunt taking charge.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: じゃあ私も子供たちを連れて行くわ。ちゃんと見送ってあげたいから。
lines.en: Then I'll bring the kids along too. I want to see him off properly.
lines.style: Resolved and gentle, warmth returning to her voice.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ありがとう。当日は黒の服でね。それが最低限の規範だから。
lines.en: Thank you. Wear black on the day — that's the basic etiquette, at minimum.
lines.style: Quietly firm, finalizing the practical details with care.
